name: Rotorcraft Engineering
summary: Helicopter and rotorcraft aerodynamics, dynamics, performance and design, from momentum theory to vibration and tiltrotors.

topics.name: Rotorcraft types: single main rotor, tandem, coaxial, compound, tiltrotor
Momentum theory in hover and axial flight
Blade element theory and combined blade-element momentum theory
Forward flight aerodynamics and the rotor disc
Rotor blade flapping, lead-lag and feathering dynamics
Swashplate and cyclic and collective control
Rotorcraft performance: hover ceiling, power required, autorotation
Rotor vibration, ground resonance and vibration control
